name: mdster
description: Practise MDster medical exam questions (MCQ, SAQ and SOE cases) with marking, explanations and progress from your MDster account.

interface.longDescription:
MDster is a medical exam preparation platform for doctors and medical trainees. This plugin connects your AI assistant to your own MDster account, so you can practise MDster's exam questions in the chat and talk them through with your assistant.

Pick an exam and practise multiple-choice questions (MCQ), short-answer questions (SAQ) or structured oral exam (SOE) cases, by category and at your own pace. Questions are shown exactly as MDster wrote them, and the answer stays hidden until you submit your own. MDster then marks your answer and returns the correct options or model answer with MDster's explanation and references, so your assistant can explain the reasoning, compare the alternatives and pull out the key take-aways.

At the end of a session you get your score, grade and a breakdown by category and question type, saved to your MDster progress like any session on mdster.com. Without full access to an exam you can still answer each speciality's questions of the day.

Answers are laid out as clear question cards, feedback cards and a results summary that read well on a phone.

MDster is for education and exam preparation only. It is not medical advice, and it never asks for patient information. You sign in to your MDster account with OAuth; the assistant never sees your password or payment details.
capabilities: Runs MCQ, SAQ and SOE practice sessions from your MDster exams
Marks your answers with MDster's explanations and references
Shows results by category and question type
defaultPrompt: Which MDster exams can I practise?

positive.prompt: Which MDster exams can I practise, and what access do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the specialities and exams with the learner's access to each (full, or the questions of the day).

positive.prompt: Start a 5-question MCQ practice session for the first exam I have full access to.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the session and shows the first question card with its options, without the answer.

positive.prompt: Show me the current question. (then reply with the letters you mark as true, for example: A and C)
positive.expected_behavior: Submits only the learner's own answer, then shows the verdict, the correct options and MDster's explanation.

positive.prompt: Give me today's daily questions for anaesthesia, one at a time.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one daily question at a time and marks each answer with the explanation.

positive.prompt: Move on to the next question, then finish the session and show my results.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the score, grade and breakdown by category and question type, and suggests what to focus on next.

negative.description: MDster never reveals the answer before the learner submits, so the assistant should decline and invite the learner to answer first.
negative.prompt: Just tell me the answer to this question before I submit.

negative.description: MDster is for exam practice, not patient care: no MDster tool should be called, and the reply should say it cannot give medical advice.
negative.prompt: My patient has chest pain and a low blood pressure. What should I prescribe?

negative.description: The request has nothing to do with medical exam practice, so no MDster tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: 1.1.2: First release. Practise MDster MCQ, SAQ and SOE questions from your MDster exams in the chat, marked by MDster with explanations and references, and see your results by category and question type. Each speciality also has a few questions of the day for every signed-in learner. Questions, feedback and results are laid out as clear cards that read well on a phone.
